source: Hypothetical design (the settings of an unused Audapter runner in blab's cerebTypicalProduction folder; the experiment as wired records through Psychtoolbox and plays no Audapter feedback): 24 kHz, downFact 2, frameLen 32 (the default), nDelay 3, no OST or PCF; bPitchShift 0 in the baseline phase, 1 in later phases. fb 1 so the speech level can be measured without the babble. Part B of the figure uses blab's timeAdapt settings (24 kHz, frameLen 48); its settings are in the export's data.json (warp).
